what: Missing publish callers for session-tmp breadcrumb NDJSON
scenario_or_breakage: Raw streams live under $IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/ and $DESIGN_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/ but larch-log commit only copies larch_log_run_dir under LARCH_LOG_ROOT; without refresh-run-logs design-log-publish or larch-log-flush wiring committed larch-logs never gain breadcrumbs/ despite new redaction logic
suggested_fix: Add explicit larch-log.sh write --batch breadcrumbs --input-dir "$SESSION_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs" --session-tmpdir ... calls in scripts/refresh-run-logs.sh scripts/larch-log-flush.sh and scripts/design-log-publish.sh (or implement-finalize Step 8/18 hooks) before commit; document caller contract in scripts/larch-log.md
